string-array.name: random_msg_after_shake
string-array.item: Background applications cleared. Everything is tidy again~
Oh my! Careful not to shake the Moon Fox dizzy... (；´∀｀)
Make sure you didn\'t leave anything important unsaved, alright?
Hold steady! Even a Sentinel loses her balance at this speed! (＞﹏＜)
Please don\'t toss your device like a Xuanfang fortune token~! (/ω＼*)
Ah—why such sudden urgency? Let me sweep the clutter for you.
Suhsin logs: Abnormal kinetic input detected. Memory purged.
Whoaa! My lanterns are swaying all over the place! Σ(っ °Д °;)っ
(Spinning like a Moon Fox chasing its tail...)
If you keep shaking like that, the Xuanfang gears might rattle loose!
A gentle breeze sweeps away the lingering tasks. All clear!
Rumor in Mengzhou says 100 shakes summons a very grumpy Moon Fox. ¯\\_(ツ)_/¯
(Moon Fox curls into a dizzy ball)
Edict complete: Zero stray background processes remain.
Hold on tight... I\'ve steadied the system for you. (*´▽`*)
Five Soaring Pillars—sweep! Every background task has been cleared.
Dustless Tread engaged. Your memory is light as autumn wind again.
Suhsin analysis: 100% of idle tasks terminated. Please stop shaking now.
